readiness_states.not_ready: one or more required preflight stages failed
readiness_states.compatibility_ready: registry, floor, manifest, and exact entry fence passed; no server artifact was supplied
readiness_states.artifact_preflight_ready: compatibility readiness plus source-bound server receipt and opened binary identity passed

limitations: a passing report does not execute the server
a passing report does not prove a bridge connection
a passing report does not replace R1-R5 compatibility evidence
the report is valid only for the exact input bytes it identifies
the report grants no game or process authority
